title: Act: Add zustand to game/frontend package.json and package-lock.json
summary: Install zustand as a runtime dependency with npm.
description: Run npm install zustand in game/frontend so package.json dependencies and package-lock.json are updated together. No other dependency changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the change, when package.json is read, then dependencies.zustand exists
Given the change, when package-lock.json is read, then node_modules/zustand is resolved
technical_constraints: Use npm, not yarn or pnpm
definition_of_done: zustand present in dependencies and lockfile

steps.action: Add the zustand runtime dependency by running npm install zustand inside game/frontend, which adds the entry to the dependencies object (not devDependencies).
Confirm npm added zustand to the root package dependencies and created a node_modules/zustand entry; lockfileVersion stays 3 and no unrelated packages change.
steps.expected: Lockfile diff only adds zustand entries.
